**Finding: deviation (LOL-CAP)** — Section 7 of the Kubient MSA is titled "Limitation of Liability" but contains only a mutual exclusion of consequential/indirect damages; there is no monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement (no "aggregate liability" or "exceed" language). Both parties' direct liability is therefore unlimited, which fails the fallback (mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs).

Redline validated (ok:true): a new Section 7(b) adding a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' amounts paid or payable between the Parties and USD 1,000,000, with Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) uncapped. Because Section 5 is a revenue-share where Kubient pays us, a "fees paid by Customer" basis would be illusory, so the cap is measured on amounts flowing between the Parties with a USD 1M floor, and Section 5 payments are excluded from the limitation.
